title: Usage window snapshots
description: usage-windows.json (data folder root): the 5-hour plan usage windows seen, so a run keeps its % after its window reset. Array of WindowSnapshot in src/usage/ticket-usage.ts; written by recordWindow (compact JSON, no final newline, atomicWrite) after each good usage answer that has a five_hour window with a reset time. Sorted by end, at most 500; a new snapshot replaces any whose end is within 15 minutes of it. Unknown fields must be kept.
